utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I’m a little worried we’ll run out of boxes and labels before the afternoon, so those should stay top priority. Can Cleo let Tess know that?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Yes — please ask Cleo to let Tess know boxes and labels are top priority. And I still need the full repair list checked plus the exact spot by the community center confirmed for me.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I can ask Cleo to let Tess know right away. I’ll also check the full repair list and confirm the exact spot by the community center.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: I can bring a hammer and a set of screwdrivers for the drive. Just let me know if Noah needs anything else.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: That’d help a lot. If Noah can spare a helper, Jules may line someone up, and Rosa’s keeping urgent safety fixes first.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sounds good — I’ll bring the hammer and screwdrivers, and I can lend a few more tools if needed. Just send me Noah’s list when you have it.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: I’ll let Mina know right away if we’re short on hands. Mara’s already asking around for folks with tools or a free hand, so hopefully we’ll have a few more helpers by afternoon.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Thanks, Tess — I’ll keep telling folks we’re collecting tools, batteries, and spare extension cords, and to drop them by Cleo’s place this evening.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Perfect, Vik — I’ll pass that along. Let’s hope the word gets around before the drive picks up this afternoon.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Sam can help with the repair drive, and they’re bringing the basic tools and gloves. Bo can help too.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: That’s really helpful, thank you. Sam’s got the donated tools covered at the Maple Street community center front desk, and I’ll wait for Quinn to keep me posted before taking anything on.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Great, I’ll keep tracking supplies here and let you know if anything else comes in for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: I’m on it — I’ll start reaching out and line up a few helpers for the repair drive at the community center. We’ve already got Gus bringing tools, and I’m checking who can bring boxes and labels before the afternoon.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Great, thanks — I’ll send Nell the time and a quick list of what folks are bringing. I can also sort the donations and keep an eye on pickup times.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Perfect — that’ll help a lot. I’ll keep asking around for boxes and labels and let you know as soon as I’ve got a few more helpers lined up.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Nice, Gus bringing the hammer and screwdrivers helps a lot. Eli’s quick list and Jules sending the time and supplies should keep everyone on the same page.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Yeah, it’s moving fast right now. I can help sort out Oren’s list of things needing fixing.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: That’d be really helpful, Rey. Once Oren’s list is sorted, we’ll know what to tackle first.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: The repair drive is still at the top, and I’m keeping the urgent safety fixes first. I’ll keep you posted as things move along.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Thanks, Sam. Please have Dane check the full repair list and confirm the exact spot so we can keep it orderly.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: I’ll ask Dane to check the full repair list and confirm the exact spot, so we can keep it orderly.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: I’ll check the full repair list and let Hana know the exact spot. I’ll also get Nell the time and a quick list of what everyone’s bringing.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Thanks, Dane — that’s perfect. Please send Hana the exact spot by the community center once you’ve checked the full list.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Will do — I’ll check the full list and send Hana the exact spot by the community center.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: I’ll keep everyone posted if anything changes. If you hear of anyone with tools or a free hand, send them my way.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I’ll keep an eye out for anyone nearby with tools or a free hand. I can also pass along the Maple Street community center front desk drop-off for the donated tools.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Thanks, Opal — that’d be a big help. If anyone can drop off donated tools at the Maple Street community center front desk, send them my way and I’ll spread the word.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I’m still gathering whatever folks can bring, and Vik’s letting the neighbors know we’re collecting tools, batteries, and spare extension cords.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, right — I can bring over a couple things this weekend. And since it’s at 10 a.m., I’ll try not to miss it.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: That’d be great, thanks. I’ll let Mara know we’re still pulling things together, and Mina can help sort it when I’m back.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: I’ll keep spreading the word and looking for folks who can come by with tools or a helping hand. And if Tess says we’re short, Mina will hear right away.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Thanks, Mara. I’ll sort items once Ira’s back, and if you hear we need boxes or labels, let me know right away.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Absolutely — I’ll let you know right away if boxes or labels are needed, and I’ll keep an eye out for more hands and tools too.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: So Bo and Sam can both help with the repair drive, right?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Yeah, that should work — I’ll help set up the repair tables and sort the donated tools. Vik’s also telling folks to drop tools, batteries, and spare extension cords by Cleo’s place this evening.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Right, so Bo and Sam are both in, yeah? And Sam’s bringing the basic tools and gloves?

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: I’ll let Mina know right away if we’re short on hands. I’ll keep asking around too and see who can spare some tools or an extra pair of hands.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Tess — that’s a big help. I’m keeping Sunday at the top for the repair drive, and I’m focusing first on the urgent safety fixes, then the things blocking daily use.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: That sounds like a good order, Rosa. I’ll keep checking for anyone with tools or an extra hand and let Mina know if we start to run short.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: It’s still at the community center, right? I can help sort things once Ira’s back.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Yep, that’s right — by the community center. I’ll sort the donated tools and keep an eye out for Rosa’s next steps too.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Good, thanks. Let me know if you need help sorting once Ira’s back.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I’m still a bit worried we’ll run out of boxes and labels before the afternoon. Can you keep an eye on what’s needed while Cleo and Jules sort the rest?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sure thing — I’ll keep an eye on the boxes and labels and let you know if we’re running low. I can also bring a hammer and screwdrivers if they help.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: That’d help a lot, thanks. Let’s keep an eye on the boxes and labels so we don’t get stuck later.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Bo and Sam can both help with the repair drive, and Sam’s bringing tools and gloves. Rosa’s pulling the details together and should send the next steps soon.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I’ll swing by your place this evening with what I can. Folks can also drop off tools, batteries, and spare extension cords there tonight.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: That sounds great — I’ll let folks know to bring tools, batteries, and spare extension cords by tonight. I’m still waiting on Rosa’s next steps, and I’ll share them as soon as they come in.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: I’ll start reaching out and line up a few helpers at the community center. I can also check who can bring boxes and labels before the afternoon.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: That sounds great, Jules. I can help with the repair drive too, and I’ll keep an eye out for anything else we need.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Thanks, Mara — I’ll spread the word and see who can bring boxes and labels before the afternoon. We’ve got the repair drive at the community center, so I’ll keep lining up a few helpers there too.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: It’s all set for now — the repair drive is at the top, and I’ve got the donated tools headed to the community center on Maple Street by the front desk.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh right, 10 a.m. makes sense. I’m glad the tools are headed over to the community center on Maple Street.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Yep, 10 a.m. works, and the repair drive is still at the top. I’ll keep the donated tools by the front desk at the community center on Maple Street.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Got it — I’ll check the full repair list and let Hana know the exact spot, and I’ll get Nell the time plus a quick list of what everyone’s bringing.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Thanks — that should keep everyone lined up. I’ll keep track of who’s bringing what and make sure the spot is clear.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Sounds good — I’ll take a look at the full repair list and send along the exact spot. If anything changes, I’ll pass it on right away.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: I’d like the full repair list checked and the exact spot by the community center confirmed before we start. Dane can still take those checks, and Jules can keep everyone posted on any helpers lined up.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I can sort Oren’s list by urgency and keep track of anything that still needs fixing. Let me know if you want me to check it against the top priorities, too.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Yes, please check it against the top priorities too. That way we can be sure the urgent repairs match the full list before Oren sets up the tables.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: I’ll sort the donations and keep an eye on pickup times. I’ll send Nell the time and a quick list of what folks are bringing.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Perfect — I’ll keep the repair drive at the top of the list and spread the word around the after-pickup window. If you want, I can also line up a couple volunteers.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Thanks, Faye — that’d be great. Nell’s already handling extra volunteers or supplies, so I’ll just keep sorting and tracking the pickup times.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: So Sam’s definitely coming with the basic tools and gloves, right? And Bo’s still on sorting donations and pickup timing?

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Yep — Sam’s coming with the basic tools and gloves, and Bo’s still on sorting donations and pickup timing. I’ll keep Uli posted, but I’m not putting them on anything yet.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Okay, just checking — Sam and Bo are still set for that, right?

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh good — Eli’s making the list, and I heard Gus can bring a hammer, screwdrivers, and some extra tools. Bo said he’d send a quick rundown of what everyone’s bringing, too.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: That’s really helpful — thank you. I’m not up for taking anything on yet, but I appreciate Quinn keeping me posted.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Of course — I’m just passing along what I’ve heard. I’ll let you know if anything else comes in about the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: We’re collecting tools, batteries, and spare extension cords—please drop them by Cleo’s place this evening. Oren’s sorting the donations and setting up the repair tables, and Ira’s checking a couple places for updates.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Thanks — that fits the repair drive. I’ll keep it to small appliances, tools, and bikes, and flag any urgent safety fixes first.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Great, that sounds perfect — small appliances, tools, and bikes, with urgent safety fixes first. Oren’ll be ready to welcome folks in as they arrive.
